compiled_note: Compiled from the review records, source configs and Census county file in this repository. No publisher file was downloaded to produce these figures.

geography_denominator.note: A count of county equivalents, not of commercial parcels.
geography_denominator.source: US Census Bureau 2020 county file, public domain, retrieved 2026-11-03 (spec/registry/county-names.tsv)

identifier_scheme: fl:parcel / fl:entity / fl:building, per the ID spec. flr1 was not adopted.

areas_not_a_single_county: 24 opt-in Minnesota counties (see the record for the list)
55 of 56 Montana counties (apartments and industrial only)
New York, Kings, Queens, Bronx and Richmond (New York City)
Guilford, Forsyth, Cumberland, Johnston and New Hanover Counties

pipeline.cited_entities_label: Sum of cited entity-registry loads. Not a live count.
pipeline.label: Sum of cited commercial-parcel rows in scratch loads. Not deduplicated, not live, not a national total.

rejected_proposals.reason: FactLot parcel IDs (fl:parcel:) are permanent. The same input must keep the same ID.

rejected_proposals.proposal: Block implementation until five unset decisions (jurisdiction list, freshness days, missing coordinates, owner display, coverage fractions) are signed, and treat null as quarantining the publish tier.
rejected_proposals.reason: Those decisions are not product policy. Scope, owner handling, coordinates and cited assessment figures already exist in the registry. Unset draft thresholds are not new gates.

rejected_proposals.proposal: Drop market value, appraised value and sale price from the registry.
rejected_proposals.reason: Those are cited source figures, not an appraisal opinion. The fact model and the Texas unequal-appraisal tools already publish them with citations.

rejected_proposals.proposal: Limit the registry to cadastral parcels and drop entities, buildings and ownership links.
rejected_proposals.reason: Entities, buildings and ownership links are current registry subjects.

rejected_proposals.proposal: Quarantine every parcel that has no coordinate.
rejected_proposals.reason: Most appraisal rolls do not publish coordinates. Missing coordinates stay unknown; a present but impossible coordinate is counted, and the row is still stored.

rejected_proposals.proposal: Treat the cited pipeline parcel sum as folklore that cannot appear even when dated and labeled.
rejected_proposals.reason: The sum of quote-checked rows is evidence of what scratch loads recorded. It is not a live count, not a national total, and not a pass threshold.

scope.entities: Registered legal entities used to resolve organisation owners, where a state file has been loaded.
scope.geography: The product state table is the 50 states, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico (STATE_BY_FIPS in the registry). Census county equivalents outside that table are listed and are not treated as reviewed.
scope.owners: Organisation owners of record only. Natural-person names are not stored.
scope.parcels: Commercial, industrial and multifamily only (state categories B, F1, F2 and subclasses). Single-family and other residential classes are out of scope.
scope.queryable_published: One downloadable District of Columbia sample. Hosted registry lookups are not open.
scope.values: Market, appraised and sale figures are stored only when the source states them, with a citation. They are not an appraisal opinion.
